notes: The fresh pages were identical to data/source (135 items, 140 dishes on the pages). An independent regex parse of the pages matched every kcal value and every Contains/May contain line for all 135 items. 15 gluten dishes (Cheeseburger, Texas Chilli Cheeseburger, Cajun Chicken Sandwich, Chicken Finger BLT, Garlic Ciabatta, Bruschetta, Mozzarella Planks, Cajun Onion Rings, kids burgers and hotdogs...) print Cereals with Gluten (Wheat) under Contains and other cereals (Barley/Oats/Rye) under May contain: tenkites_b drops that may-contain, so the app showed only the contained kind; tgi_fridays_pages.py now keeps the key so allergens.csv publishes generic gluten (policy 2). Vegan BBQ Burger held back: no gluten/cereal marked for a burger (every other burger marks gluten). Descriptions scanned for missing allergens: nothing else clear.
